exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Social media Which social media websites do you use?

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Social media How much time do you spend on social media sites? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Social media What kind of information about yourself have you put on social media? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Social media Is there anything you don’t like about social media? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe something you liked very much which you bought for your home. You should say: what you bought when and where you bought it why you chose this particular thing and explain why you liked it so much.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Creating a nice home Why do some people buy lots of things for their home?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Creating a nice home Do you think it is very expensive to make a home look nice?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Creating a nice home Why don’t some people care about how their home looks?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Different types of home In what ways is living in a flat/apartment better than living in a house?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Different types of home Do you think homes will look different in the future?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Different types of home Do you agree that the kinds of homes people prefer change as they get older?
